SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE [d360].[TOP_CORP_PH]
( 
	[YEAR] [numeric](10,0)  NULL,
	[RANK] [numeric](10,0)  NULL,
	[COMPANY_NAME] [varchar](150)  NULL,
	[GROSS_REVENUE] [VARCHAR](18)  NULL,
	[Source] [varchar](50)  NULL
)
WITH (DATA_SOURCE = [testsqlpool_ext], LOCATION = N'dev/decrypted/EXTERNAL/DID/', FILE_FORMAT = [csv2], REJECT_TYPE = VALUE, REJECT_VALUE = 0 )
GO


SELECT 
MAX(LEN(YEAR)) YEAR,
MAX(LEN(RANK)) RANK,
MAX(LEN(COMPANY_NAME)) COMPANY_NAME,
MAX(LEN(GROSS_REVENUE)) GROSS_REVENUE,
MAX(LEN(Source)) Source
FROM  [d360].[TOP_CORP_PH]

select * from [d360].[TOP_CORP_PH] order by rank


---Create external DataSource
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE Datasource_sqlpool_ext
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'abfss://data360@cbcd360devstoacct01sg.dfs.core.windows.net'
);

---Create external File format
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT csv3
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT,
    FORMAT_OPTIONS (FIELD_TERMINATOR= '|', FIRST_ROW = 2, DATE_FORMAT = 'yyyy-MM-dd')
    
);

---Create external table
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE [d360].[TOP_CORP_PH]
( 
	[YEAR] [numeric](10,0)  NULL,
	[RANK] [numeric](10,0)  NULL,
	[COMPANY_NAME] [varchar](150)  NULL,
	[GROSS_REVENUE] [VARCHAR](18)  NULL,
	[Source] [varchar](50)  NULL
)
WITH (DATA_SOURCE = [Datasource_sqlpool_ext], LOCATION = N'dev/decrypted/EXTERNAL/DID/', FILE_FORMAT = [csv3], REJECT_TYPE = VALUE, REJECT_VALUE = 0 );

select * from [d360].[TOP_CORP_PH] order by rank
